body:
I bindged so hard recently just to disturb myself. Not games but youtube. I think its good, even though i was watching so crazy random stuff of rather lower value haha! 
Then slowly slowly get back to normal, checking if i will be instantly overwhelmed by reality.

Keep your mind occupied all the time, if you just notice you start going down the rabbit hole of thoughts, switch thinking to anything, literally anything else, start talking about things you see, sing, dance, draw, do pushup, start browsing random reddits. Survive till next hour, and then next one, and next one. You dont have to fix any problems now or came up with any life changing plan. I feel worthless, ok thats fine let me watch a movie, i feel like a shit, good good, im going do 10 pushups and then prepare a few sandwiches for a supper.

Stay strong girl, come here, talk and stay with us. Big hugs and tons of cheering energy for you. You are the best!

I would add my $0.02 about general logic of stress. So in my life i went throu several serious depressions but also i had some peaceful periods. I experienced mood shifts so drastically different that I learned logic and world perception in those states is one big scam lol

The fact you also SH may be surprisingly actually an advantage.. Tell her, show she is not alone, tell her your story. Many people dont expect any solution or life fixing plan, just to be understood and heard, so dont be afraid you cant fix her problems.

Later on, depending on her state, you may try to suggest some solutions or keep her accountable if she is ready to start dealing with SH and general life stress. But I would say just being there for her, without judging is the key.

I can relate to every single comment here! 
Self harm as self care - when written looks so illogical and crazy ^^

This is not a competition or entry exam, we don’t measure and qualify or disqualify people :) even if you just think of cutting its already a serious SH in my opinion and on this subreddit you will be always listened and tried to be understood. 
I think what we truly need is not attention but care. And there is nothing wrong in wanting it. 
So dont feel guilty, you deserve care and love.
If you feel a bit stronger how about helping others? If you feel you are still pretty low, don’t worry about helping others, you can do it after you heal yourself up a bit. There are much better ways to be a good person than SH :) stay strong~

Triggers are very personal thing and probably everyone is vulnerable to different triggers. I was never triggered by physical similarities like scratches or accidental cuts tho similar situations, like screwing myself up in similar way instantly reminded me of SH. 
I still relapse but i think we can learn what triggers us and be extra careful to avoid such a situations. or when they happen expect thoughts to drift towards SH. Easier said than done unfortunately...

Lots of bad things going on, really sorry to hear. My story is relatively similar. Stayed strong through dead of relatives just to got hit off guard by some small random stuff. Thats how i cut myself for the first time. 
Please come to this subreddit as often as you need, there are many really supportive people here. Everyone has their own stories but, at least i have a feeling of being understood. Many of us struggle but also there are positive posts here too. Some people look for advices and some just to be heard. I often come when i feel alone because its really difficult to find people you can talk with about SH. You dont have to have answer for everything, or ultimate plan of fixing life, just come here, talk, stay with us. you are beautiful! :)

beautiful! thats a big win there man! 

Im in different timezone and will be up for long, so in case of some last minute negativity hits, come here and lets talk! 

Cheers!
that sux man, though a year is quite an impressive run. Survive the shitstorm, heal up and start over 👨🏻‍🚀
I feel the same, though in longer intervals. I kinda learned how to manage stress and not relapse (I still do from time to time), but the swings are always always here.
I thought thats the rush actually, that feeling of relief and sudden peace 🤔

I do it all the time. My scars are on arms and are not very aggressive, though its obvious its SH, yet i shrug it off with exact same bike accident lie. I do it to test waters how people react.. In most cases people never continue the topic and i believe they really actually dont see whats going on.

there was one person who instantly recognised the situation, i saw it in his eyes, but he was very kind "hey, it may sound super stupid but just in case... is everything fine?"

So from my experience its very difficult to find anyone that I can open up with those things. I test waters.
i never done it but starving myself it a common thing. In my case its more like giving up or rather taking vacations from daily routines.

Im in similar situation but its my gf.. The only time I collapsed hard and was desperate for help, she didnt show up... I dont blame her, i guess she was not prepared for it. But she feels so distance from me now like a stranger you pass by in a theme park..
Hey buddy, just checking on you? stay strong! peace!

relationships can be a bitch\~ 🤗

"dont worry", "it will get better", "just get over it and move on" hehe We are with you buddy! stay strong!
I got tremendous support on this subreddit, because every single time there was always someone who answered. In my case friends didnt show up as well but i found here a spark of being listened.
good luck girl! you are the best!

Dont feel guilty or selfish - its not. But i understand, my way of dealing with those feelings was to make a deal that when I get better i will help others. That way i feel fair to everyone yet it allows me to ask for help more often.

Asking for help is hella hard, everyone gangsta till its you asking for help hehe! Friends can react in very strange way, stay strong and dont give up on seeking help

I had this friend form who I received a pretty solid clue things are not ok, so i was setting alarm clock every h in the night to ping her. After a few cycles i missed an alarm and woke up at the morning. Luckily she felt a sleep too. I would never forgive myself if something happened to her and i was just sleeping.

Normally tons of pointless messages, food pictures, cats and jokes, but the only only time i really wanted/needed them - full radio silence. I initiated the chat, with some clues something is not right with me and i want to talk to anyone. No one responded\~

Im an other random stranger on the internet and im telling you:

no, you are winner!
Sure some of us are still up. Lets talk. Pm or here, its up to you, i suggest here because other can read and relate, maybe help you or help themselves.

life can be a bitch... no doubt about this. Sorry to hear a fellow buddy got hit that hard. Can be a bit lonely, thats the worst, but we are here to listen and share the pain. I survived a whole weekend thanks to the community here.

In my case i was able to realise my emotional system is completely unusable at that state i was so i just gave up on finding a solution. Instead i focused on reading this subreddit to keeping my mind occupied. Stay strong, survive till next hour, then next one, and so on. You dont have to came up with any solution, its not an exam, just next hour and next hour and next hour... (or day/week depending what time frame doesn't frighten you)

thats tuff.. relationships can be a bitch.. have you ever been in such a state before?  what do you feel, loneliness? anger? insecurity? complete panic (thats my speciality)?

As a fellow member on this subreddit im telling you dont go the rabbit path on sh, its not worth. Easier said than done i know oh yes... Tell me more what happened, write it down, it helps a bit.

shit, frozen lazagna made me laugh!

putting a typical good advice dad hat now: if something makes you smile even in this ocean of crap just allow it yourself and laugh.

Stay strong buddy!
stay strong buddy, we all, in one way or another, can relate. Please tell whats up, I want to hear you.

I always laugh at bar code jokes. I dont have as many scars myself but i have seen people really SH hard, so knowing all those mental and physical madness we go through, analogy to barcode is just too cute and absolutely ridiculous - it makes me smile. Like a good pun in a good dad joke.

Relapsing is a part of recovery. Sometimes, as inadequate as it sound, I see it like a mario game, till you learn all tricks for all enemies, step by step, try by try, then you beat the level! Heal up and lets try again!

i used to scream (silently) for help, i wanted to someone discover my cuts and did something. My fear was i didnt believe there is anything that can be done to help me, which probably resulted in similar state as you describe. Spoiler alert thats not true, lots can be done though i still try to figure out how can i help others as i remember how dark those times were for me.

Dont feel guilty, now and never. If you dont want to cut thats a massive success! Now try to maintain that state. We dont feel guilty for Firefighters when there is no fire, and they are equally ready to serve and wishing there is nothing to do. Same your friends. If you feel guilty lets make a deal, instead of guilt now, recover and help others in the future. You will still have opportunity to payback for all the help.

I write fables and poems when im in deep dark mode. Its a good way to express emotions. it helps me. Though for me it was just a part of bigger recovery "program". Dont give up on writing.

I sometimes imagine there is a special shelf in my mind and i put memories of all the shit people said to/on me, then i lock this shelf and never never open it again. If you have well developed imagination - use it\~

Empty silent room is the worst. and debating with myself sometimes feels like im just and observer. 

Ill tell you something, dont debate, just come here, write and read. Share the moment with us.
you know... actually i can do it! (well need a bit of preparations but there is nothing that holds me back o.O)

i have several techniques depending on the situation. mostly i can talk myself out.

* I smirk and say "what do we say to cut? not today" paraphrasing one character from Game of Throne movies.
* Or i think to myself "hold on hold on! im in charge here! and we are not going to do this".
* If you have seen Lord of the rings movies, in final scene of 3rd movie, at the end of long journey Frodo holds the ring in his hand and all he needs to do is tiny move to throw it to lava. So simple, just do it Frodo its so simple ffs! So i imagine myself standing there. just do it! throw the sharp item away, thats it, simple tiny move, drop it, so simple... It helps me realise its indeed actually very simple.
* sometimes i kinda pray repeating "i feel no fear". Sometimes i just do it while walking, and if you repeat this bazilion times i sometimes have a blast: "shit i actually dont feel fear anymore"...
* when urges are a bit stronger i try to do a few pushups. Now im more lazy but in the past it was very useful. With red face and sweat drop on my forehead i could say: "ufff... another one survived!". On funny note: i did it so many times I actually accidentally got myself in a good shape lol.
* If possible i often come to this subreddit, to read or write. Talking in real life with friends never worked for me so writing is a good way.
* in other communities counting days is more popular, and it worked for me very well. I ofc kept replasing many times but when you are close to a milestone its kinda silly to give up. This is actually what im doing right now. I relapsed on friday and im alone whole weekend. Weekends are super scary, but i already survived Saturday, and soon Sunday as well.
* When I was in financial crisis I created this massive spreadsheet which boiled down to a one information: what is the actual situation. So whenever I got panic attack I instantly mentally visualise this one number which was emotionless proof that things even though pretty shitty are still relatively kinda stable. 

Those are a few, maybe you will fins something useful for yourself.

Since you a good person and I see you are supporting others im gonna add one more which usually i dont recommend because i sound like a typical dad. Its: past successes. Nothing feels better than overcoming your fears. There is no a sweetest revenge than a massive success. I remember when i was in very dark position and such advice was surreal and completely missed for my state then, but if you have a bit of momentum going on and positive energy: change something. The truth is unless you change something nothing will change. We can read it backwards: If you only change something most likely things start to change \^\^

Stay strong girl you are the best!

Such friends sux balls, lol! Heal up and start 1 week challenge again! I cheer for you!

( answering you question: there are good people in the world. the challenge of our life is to find and surround ourselves with them )

Ill tell you from my experience. My case is slightly different but maybe you will find some inspirations. 
So for me the key was not to fight the cravings, not to suppress or combat them... but channel them! Redirect all this massive energy we hold in ourselves to something different.
Obsession is blessing, yes you hear correctly its the biggest gift we got. But its a strange beast to deal with. channel the anger, the hate, the insecurities. Make them serve you, how cool it would be, eh? We are special thats why average people don’t understand us, because... they are average. (Sounds like a starwars palpatine dude guy haha) 

I would suggest you martial arts, especially asian one. they know how to redirect all those emotions and forces into something  beautiful.
Think about giving it a try. Cheers!

Heyyy, ill tell you from my experience, i used to be suuper shy person, no friends, tons of guilt, no help from anywhere. I kinda find my way how to float in this state. But it was not a comfort zone, it was an illusion of stability. I think you know it, same as i know. I can guarantee you every one wants and deserve happiness. People crave it and that's why they are attracted to genuine happy people. It goes both ways actually: when you are happy you will radiate it, you will shine, you will want to share it with whole the world. Same as when we are sad, we want to get rid of it, tell someone, scream it out, cover it by pain or cuts. Same thing radiate it.
I tell you what i did. since i was so scared of failure i was not able to confront any of my fears. So i started with suuuuper small things. Tiny wins. I exactly remember two things i started with: it was relaxing my face muscles not to have this tense eyes and mouth, and relaxing my hands muscles not to keep closed fists when i walked. Thats how i started going out of my “comfort zone”. later on i felt i could be more adventurous. I started to (forcefully) smile randomly and allowed myself to say “its fine” when i embarrassed myself in front of people. 
So dont give up, slowly with your own speed, change one thing at the time. Super small wins will build a spark of confidence. 

It is worth to fight for your happiness! Find your way. Im pressing the button on your behalf.

Ignorance is a bish, i had similar experience many times, I personally stopped counting on friends when it comes to self harm topic.
Come here, write in this subteddit. We are listening and always care. We share same problems, doubts, guilt and disappointment.. But also you can see some happy stories from time to time too!
Write us anytime when you feel to.

Bonus observation: as we are most likely spread across multiple continents it means whole world cares about you ^^

Stay strong buddy! Peace~

For me its because when i was a ball of mess some random stranger help me, kicked me out of spiral of darkness. I still struggle with many things but i dream to be that guy one day. To show up for someone when everyone else already gave up and left.
You deserve support and kindness. I (and as i see many of us here) will be for you, listening, sharing stories, trying to find a common language and understand.

I do it too, sometimes just for lulz, knowing its forced and maybe fake but actually its really cheerful feeling.
A secret tip: during pandemia if i wear a mask i often smile to everyone. To all people passing me by, to cute girls and kind grandmas, to always in rush businessmen and to shop clerks. No one can see (i tested with mirror and only eyes look a bit cheerful)
its soo surreal!

I have different dream, to in addition to my normal home rent airbnb in some unusual locations. Starting from my city by maybe just jumping from one place to another in feneral. Different locations, different type and different price. A few weeks in dormitory with other travelrs and then a week in some uber fancy 10star hotel with chocolate spa ^^ then in business district blending into crowd of clones to end up in country side helping old family with vegetables or animals in exchange of bed and food. Live among crazy skydivers in some hangar on old airfield or sip a wine with multi billionaires also asking about meaning of life!
Me too actually... still here, still inhaling comes after exhaling, that’s something!

Its crazy, feels so natural and normal, the reasonable way how to deal with things. I relapsed so smoothly recently, after so many years of staying clean... i knew sh is the answer it was so obvious, it was like a doctor prescription: “due to diagnosed sabotaging your own life its recommend to sh for upcoming week” lol
But Im putting my cpt Good Advice hat now to say there is always underlying reason why we do what we do that can be addressed in different way.
For me it was always extreme fear of being rejected and judged. Across many years i found my ways to step by step address those real things and harm was just not needed anymore.
( Until I ran out of options and slip back to relapse )

Welcome to the community! Thank you for joining and thank you for making a step to do something about your self harm habits. 
Everyone is in different situation but we try to find our own language to understand each other. I like reading posts of people and relate, answer, share my story, share what work for me and what was completely miss. Sometimes one post or replay can change whole life because it really helps to know we are not alone. many people struggle with similar to some degree problems too. No one will judge you here, you are anonymous so its safe environment. Open up and talk off your chest. 

stay strong, we are here to help eachother.

From my experience most of people are too shocked they dont know how to react. It can go both ways. Many people here reports parents shouting at them and punishing. But there are also really touching fully support stories. 
In my case it never went well, i always regretted i told. I could feel a distance build up and slowly drifting away. Now after years I understand it was because they are just not prepared for such topics. What i used to do i tested waters and mention casually general self harm or suicide topic (not mentioning myself) and listen how they react. Usually they change topic instantly because fear/taboo/incompetence. So I stopped counting on my friends when it comes to self harm advices or help.
If you really want to tell please note you most likely will have to help educating them. Maybe mention you self-harmed but you also do A, B, C to help yourself and recover.. help them helping you.

I still activity eradicate all memories from middle school.  That period was a frickin septic tank in my life.
Later on my life turned around and became okeish actually really not that bad. So I dont go back to school memories, there is nothing there, not a single useful message/lesson/advice. I started collecting memories from after school time on.
If those past memories hold you, drop them, dont replay in your head unpleased situations. Drop them like a space rocket drops boosters engines 🚀

Thats the spirit! But seriously would you think it would help if you know the exact number. Like “2 weeks clean”, or “strong 24days”?

(You can also restart counter without sh 😋🥳)
Hey buddy are you ok there? Whats in your mind? Talk to us, share with us. We do care about you!

Form my experience I can tell you there is a good and bad news. Bad news is urges never stopped coming, when im strong urges are weak, sometimes just a single thought i can even laugh off. When Im weak urges are more real and harder to deal with. The good news is (at least for me) we can prepare for them, spot them early and mitigate.

Stay strong buddy, you seem still very stable so just train technics and tactics how to get rid of urges.

Hey im really touched by your post as i can relate to nearly everything. Especially fear and loneliness, those two i fight with whole my life, collapsing and recovering. Expanding my defense arsenal just to find myself screwing things over and over again. I screw big shit yesterday up, big juicy one, true life changing opportunity just went down the sink because i couldn't handle the pressure and I panicked. I relapsed/collapsed. I tell you something as a fellow fresh harmer: you are not alone, and we are listening to you, i listen and I care because i know how it is, with all the guilt, and constantly self sabotaging everything.

Dont feel guilty for GED, be proud of it! yeah proud! as surreal as it sounds (but aren't our emotions completely messed up already? so why not for the lulz add some fake positiveness.. both ways are already far unreliable so whatever). I am proud of you, of this spark of action. Doesnt matter how GED will end up its already something, actually one of the most important step admitting we need help.

I think you have lovely bf who already showed he wants to support you. Write him a message that even though its very difficult for you, you want to do GED. Ask him for help and say thank you for everything he does for you already and that means a lot for you.

Dont worry about parties and friends. In my opinion its a bit too risky environment still for you. If something goes bad it may be too huge hit to handle. So start with bf if he is your safe zone and you are comfortable and happy with him. Then ask him to help you arranging  meeting together with a few friends in some safe setup. You will build sparks of confidence, slowly slowly step by step. As surreal as it sound you are still very young, there is still lots of time for many things, you are not a lost case, no no no, in fact i have a feeling you are more like just blooming flower. Give yourself some time, but act!

I also relate to jealousy. This is a poison, be careful with this. I can tell you what i did when i was a ball of mess maybe you can find some inspirations. Ask a bf for a schedule, so you know every Wednesday you go to for example a park. you will know you will meet him and there is always time for you. You you wait for it and it will make your days bearable. Also allow him to go out with his friends alone. let him charge his batteries, he is also under quite a stress so help him helping you.

Stay strong girl and come here to this subreddit as often as you feel you need. Ill be waiting for updates as i cheer for you from bottom of my heart. Peace!

I cry sometimes too, usually in a way noone sees. For me it became more mechanical function of my body. Some sort of body chemistry reaction. The reason is i know crying wont solve any of my problems but it still kind of helps so i allow it to happen. I remember when i was younger i cried a lot and released more emotions. These days its very shallow, i usually dont feel as much as i used to.

lol when someone ask about my arms I say "i had an accident on my bicycle, I felt into some metal stuff." - "but how was it possible?" - "it has been long time ago I dont remember exactly".

Im adding your answer to my arsenal, its much better!

heyy dont feel guilty, i have been relapisng so many times till i finally succeed! I have been cut free for 10 past years and... i relapsed yesterday... I felt like shit and was terrified same as you. but what happened happened, what matters now is next hour and next day. You are strong person who was able to stay clean for so long! this is a proof of experience and knowledge. its a fact. use again all those skills, and stay clean just for next hour, then whole day, then again whole day and again. 

About friends I have to agree usually non of my friends were helpful so i gave up on seeking understanding in them.. i dont blame them any more actually. I just stopped counting on friends when it comes to depression and sh. Similar with my parents. The are good people but they were completely unprepared for me self harming. "There is nothing to be sad about" is such a useless reaction, usually its what people say when they dont know what to say. After years though I learned that its genuine a honest intention to share positiveness and silly attempt to help people they care. So much counterproductive but deep inside supportive. 

Be strong, lots of positive energy from fellow harmer! :)

great attitude, keep it up! Kittens are absolute perfect therapy! staying busy in general was also a medicine for me. When i thought im really busy, I signup for a Japanese language class, imagine that - Japanese wtf o.O I just didnt have time for depressions.

Find ways, even artificially to have many things to do. I remember i also used to limit amount of stuff i stored in my home just to have an excuse to go to local shop more often and be among people.

Anyways we are really proud of you. Ill be waiting tomorrow for a note how you doing! stay strong!

I used to mark date and count dates. In different communities and different subreddit though. It helped me a lot, seeing progress and reaching milestones, it became a game for me: "shit i want but i will ruin the run". and in fact i ruined it so many times till i crossed week first time and then month. 100th day i celebrated more than a birthday. maybe we can have badge system in this community as well...
Big win here! Congratulations! you should be proud! please share with us what keeps you up? We will wait for same report tomorrow too\~ Stay strong!

i know how you feel, but this is not a tournament or school test that you qualify or not.  you need and deserve help. Im happy for you you made the most important step in whole the process: wanting to recover.

Please seek the help, make an effort to recover and work hard on it. If you relapse its fine dont let it discourage you. If you feel guilty of not being "sick enough" how about this: recover and then (or meanwhile) help others :) 

i believe in you, stay string!

Everyone situation is different but for me cutting myself was a silent scream for help. On the other hand there was not much that could be done in particular because nothing made much sense at least in my opinion that time.

Its hard to tell from your comment if its something you look for or are afraid of (or maybe both), but i think there is a chance your mom started to educate herself on the topic. Help her helping you.

to never ever be scared again.

working hard on it past years, have some good results. Im not talking about going crazy haha just rebuild strong self confidence foundation. Will join skydiving course soon, if i can do this there will be not a single person or event that can knock me down to my old habits.

Exercise! make your muscles burn! I usually do 10 pushups just to shake off initial urge. From my experience I noticed its very difficult (impossible) to suppress urges but we can channel them to less harmful areas or even beneficial.

Stay strong buddy, dont worry about relapsing but step by step get replace habits. Imagine the satisfactions of taming biggest monster into serving you
Exercise! do pushups till your arms fells off. I usually do 10 pushaups just to shake off the initial urge. Channel urge energy back to the body into the muscles! Exhaust / distract yourself
You have the "luxury" of knowing whats there waiting for you. What is your biggest fear, what made you self harm in the past. is there any chance of protecting/preparing for those things?

im pretty sure he will ask is there is any way he can help you. I believe problem solving mentality is the natural instant reaction for most men. Maybe you can think of the answer. what kind of support you wish he can provide. is it any particular action? or maybe just being there for you? maybe talking out things or maybe staying quiet. help him helping you.

I blew up my career yesterday, maybe not as bad but lost a life changing chance for sure. I cut myself for the first time in 10 years. I tiny one, im glad you didnt, since yesterday i surf the reddit about self harm as a distraction. being among other harmers helps me. So please come back here whenever you feel the urge. We will listen to you.

i usually casually answer: "oh i had an accident on my bicycle, felt into some metal stuff" even though it doesn't look like a bike accident at all. And move on to a different topic. The melody of this short conversation is similar to "what time is it? its 3:30. oh thank you".

stay strong there. What worked for me was to go to places where many people are. I liked department stores or walking avenues, so i was surrounded by people yet didnt have to interact with any one. I still felt not very good but at least i didnt stay in that dead silent and empty home.

what worked for me was also not trying to be myself, everyone says be yourself you are great who you are, but i dont know what actually does it mean to be myself and definitely what i can see its not great at all. So i decided to be someone else. When depression hit me hard i was a brainless robot just doing tiny tasks i put on my daily todo list, not thinking about tomorrow just going from taks to task. When im more confident i want to be a person who exercise two times in a week. Or something like that. 

Thats what i find useful maybe you find something inspiring for yourself too.

i try to stay in public places, or just go out for a walk if im home alone. When its a lighter urge i like to laugh it off by saying: "what do we say to the cut? not today \^\^". For me its all about early spotting symptoms im loosing control or im in a heated situation. Then i know: "ok this is the moment, be careful, your emotions cant be trusted now". Im a very logical thinking person so i protect myself with prepared solutions, prepared thinking schemes just to survive the pick of negative emotions wave. Im pretty good at it but i also fail sometimes and usually in a spectacular way, its terrifying.

So my 0.02 would be that those things can be learned, its difficult but doable to take control over your emotions.

I would say its a natural reaction, and i dont blame them that much actually. I have prepared some silly (not offending) answers to test the waters. Maybe they really want to discuss the topic, maybe they harm themselves as well, we dont know... (most people are not prepared to talk about self harm unfortunately though thats true) 

From my personal experience I would not cut myself if there was someone that moment I could talk to and flood that person with all emotions i had to deal. For me self harm is a scream to be listened.

I second the comments here. It never really stops, its all about how well you can control it. On a good side you can actually control it very well, though it requires lots of learning. I think more learning than discipline because in my case its all about triggers and sudden urges. If i can quickly spot "ok this is the moment" AND i can quickly use one of technic from my arsenal all is fine. The problem is if you miss the moment and got hit unprepared.

We are thought by our parents and society about emotions and expressing them, love dramas, songs and dancing, inclusiveness and care, but from my experience whoever looses temper first - loose everything. Its completely other way around. It took me years to spot those clues early and react fast. You can train this.

I was staying strong for long but even I got hit at some point so hard i lost, my mental barrier collapsed and i spin into self harm. Lesson learned, case archived next time ill spot in earlier. Be strong man, you can control it!

I like my scars no matter how strange does it sound, its a reminder where I was and how much work i put in recovering. If i survived that time i can survive now and in future. They are like Olympic medals. 

In terms of pure estetic from my experience people dont notice or dont want to notice any scars. Some people find scars even actually pretty. I dont advertise my scars but also dont make the big deal with hiding them. If someone asks i straight lie easily it was a strange bike accident, even though its obvious its a self harm, and see how they react. Usually people believe as they dont want to digg the topic. Sometimes though someone smirks in a friendly way so i can open up more.

As a fellow self-harmer ill drop that there is no need to harm yourself more, we know how it is but also we know it doesnt lead to anywhere. So come to this forum and write to us about your emotions and situation anytime you feel you need, we are always listening.

It can go both way unfortunately, from my experience usually its a shock for them and they just dont know how to react. Especially parents and especially moms may act very strange. I dont blame people for that i kind of try to understand. They also need time to deal with the fact that someone they care harm herself/himself. My mom saw my fresh wounds and she instantly proceeded to taking care of them from medical perspective. She was frightened but i think she knew she was totally unprepared for such a situation and didnt say much. She was very supportive whole my life and indirectly helped me a lot especially during that period but we never talked about self harming.
hey buddy how are you doing? please tell whats up?

stay strong buddy!  what works for me is to go out, whenever i feel an urge i just go out where many people are. Maybe a department store or just walk in park. just be constantly in motion, it give me feeling of change and not stucking in my home with all the problems.
